    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">集合与索引类异常【C# Exception 详解系列（三）】</span>

        本文主要介绍：集合与索引异常，主要包括这几种：IndexOutOfRangeException、KeyNotFoundException、ArrayTypeMismatchException、RankException、InvalidOperationException。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>〇、前言</h2>
<p>前文已经列举了全部有哪些常见的异常类型，本文继续介绍下各个类别的异常特点。</p>
<p>本文主要介绍：<strong>集合与索引异常</strong>，主要包括这几种：<strong>IndexOutOfRangeException、KeyNotFoundException、ArrayTypeMismatchException、RankException、InvalidOperationException</strong>。</p>
<p>点击链接可以查看本系列文章：<span style="font-size: 12px"><em><a title="https://www.cnblogs.com/hnzhengfy/category/2537680.html" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/hnzhengfy/category/2537680.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">C# Exception 详解系列</a>。</em></span></p>
<h2>一、集合与索引类异常总览</h2>
<table style="width: 91.3151%">
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="width: 14.8611%">异常</th>
<th style="width: 31.1111%">谁抛的</th>
<th style="width: 19.8611%">一句话原因</th>
<th style="width: 34.1667%">首选替代方案</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="width: 14.8611%"><code>IndexOutOfRangeException</code></td>
<td style="width: 31.1111%">数组、string、<code>Span&lt;T&gt;</code>、<code>Memory&lt;T&gt;</code>、多维数组</td>
<td style="width: 19.8611%">下标 &lt;0 或 ≥ Length</td>
<td style="width: 34.1667%">判 <code>Length</code>/<code>Count</code>、<code>^</code> 与范围、<code>ElementAtOrDefault</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 14.8611%"><code>KeyNotFoundException</code></td>
<td style="width: 31.1111%"><code>Dictionary</code>/<code>ConcurrentDictionary</code>/<code>SortedDictionary</code> 的 <code>[key]</code></td>
<td style="width: 19.8611%">键不存在</td>
<td style="width: 34.1667%"><code>TryGetValue</code>、<code>GetValueOrDefault</code>(.NET 8+)、<code>TryAdd</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 14.8611%"><code>ArrayTypeMismatchException</code></td>
<td style="width: 31.1111%">协变数组写入时</td>
<td style="width: 19.8611%">运行时实际数组装不下这个类型</td>
<td style="width: 34.1667%">别用协变数组，改用 <code>List&lt;T&gt;</code>/<code>IReadOnlyList&lt;T&gt;</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 14.8611%"><code>RankException</code></td>
<td style="width: 31.1111%"><code>Array.Copy</code>/<code>CopyTo</code>/<code>ConstrainedCopy</code> 等</td>
<td style="width: 19.8611%">源与目标维度数(Rank)不同</td>
<td style="width: 34.1667%">判 <code>Rank</code>、<code>GetLength(d)</code>，分清交错数组与多维数组</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 14.8611%"><code>InvalidOperationException</code></td>
<td style="width: 31.1111%">枚举器版本校验、空集合取元素等</td>
<td style="width: 19.8611%">集合被改 / 对象处于错误状态</td>
<td style="width: 34.1667%">倒序遍历、快照、<code>RemoveAll</code>、并发集合</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i10.39f22988AvgD5q">这 5 个异常有一个共同点：</span><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">它们几乎都代表“程序逻辑错了”，而不是“用户输入不好”</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">。因此通用策略是“用检查或更安全的 API 把异常消灭在发生之前”，而不是在外层&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">catch</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。唯一例外是&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">InvalidOperationException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i19.39f22988AvgD5q">，它有一半场景是状态机/并发问题，需要靠设计来规避。</span></p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i23.39f22988AvgD5q">核心原则</span></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">：凡是能通过长度判断、</span><code class="qk-md-code">Try*</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;API、不可变快照或类型系统（泛型不变性）在编译期/调用期挡住的，就不要留给运行时去抛。</span></strong></span></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">这五个异常里，除了&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">InvalidOperationException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;的一半场景需要靠并发设计解决，其余四个都可以做到“线上零出现”。</span></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1868241/202610/1868241-20261026142451766-1640353331.png" alt="image"></span></p>
<h2>二、各个异常简介与简单示例</h2>
<h3>2.1 IndexOutOfRangeException —— 越界访问</h3>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i25.39f22988AvgD5q">触发条件</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：下标&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">&lt; 0</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;或&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">≥ Length</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">注意它是“数组/连续内存”语义的异常：</span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><code class="qk-md-code">string[i]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">T[]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">Span&lt;T&gt;</code></span><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">、多维数组都会抛它；而&nbsp;</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><code class="qk-md-code">List&lt;T&gt;[i]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;抛的是&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentOutOfRangeException</code></span></span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">——这是面试和排障时最容易记混的一点。</span></p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>// ① 切分后想当然地取下标（外部数据最常见）
var parts = "a,b".Split(',');
var third = parts[2];                 // 💥 IndexOutOfRangeException

// ② 差一错误（&lt;=）
int[] a = new int[5];
for (int i = 0; i &lt;= a.Length; i++)   // 💥 i == 5 时
    a[i] = i;

// ③ C# 8 的 ^ 运算符：^0 本身就是非法的
var last = a[^0];                     // 💥 永远是越界，编译不报错

// ④ 多维数组按“扁平思维”访问
int[,] m = new int[3, 4];
var v = m[0, 12];                     // 💥 每维独立校验

// ✅ 正确姿势
if (parts.Length &gt; 2) third = parts[2];          // 明确长度判断
third = parts.ElementAtOrDefault(2) ?? "";       // LINQ，性能略低但安全
var last = a[^1];                                // ^1 才是最后一个
// Span/Memory 场景用 TrySlice / Slice 前先判 Length
if (span.Length &gt;= 3) var chunk = span.Slice(0, 3);</code></pre>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i29.39f22988AvgD5q">特别注意：</span></span></div>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">性能层面</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：JIT 会把循环内的边界检查“提升”到循环外（bounds check elision），所以<strong>手动加&nbsp;</strong></span><strong><code class="qk-md-code">if (i &lt; len)</code></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete"><strong>&nbsp;不会拖慢，反而常能帮 JIT 消除检查</strong>；但</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">不要用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">unsafe</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;指针去绕开检查来换性能</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">，越界会变成内存破坏，难以复现。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">空集合取&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">[0]</code></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;是线上最高频的越界来源之一，尤其&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">FirstOrDefault()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;之后没判默认值、</span><code class="qk-md-code">Split</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/正则匹配结果为空、JSON 数组为空。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">多线程共用一个可变下标（共享&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">int index++</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">）也会偶发越界，这类 bug 只在压测时出现。</span></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.2 KeyNotFoundException —— 字典键不存在</h3>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>// 异常触发示例
var cfg = new Dictionary&lt;string, string&gt; { ["Host"] = "localhost" };
var port = cfg["Port"];             // 💥 The given key 'Port' was not present in the dictionary.

// ✅ 单次查找：TryGetValue（避免 ContainsKey + 索引器 的两次哈希）
if (cfg.TryGetValue("Port", out var port)) { ... }

// ✅ .NET 6+：直接给默认值，语义最干净
var port = cfg.GetValueOrDefault("Port", "5432");

// ✅ 需要“没有就插入”时，避免两次查找（.NET 7+）
ref var val = ref CollectionsMarshal.GetValueRefOrAddDefault(cfg, "Port", out bool exists);
val = "5432";   // ref 直接写回，零额外分配、零二次哈希

// ✅ 并发场景
var cd = new ConcurrentDictionary&lt;string,int&gt;();
cd.GetOrAdd("k", _ =&gt; Compute());   // 不要 cd["k"] ?? cd["k"] = ...</code></pre>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i35.39f22988AvgD5q">特别注意：</span></span></div>
<ol class="qk-md-ol" start="1">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">键的等价性</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：自定义类型作键必须同时重写&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">GetHashCode</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;与&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Equals</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（</span><code class="qk-md-code">record</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/</span><code class="qk-md-code">record struct</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;已合成）；用</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">可变对象或数组当键</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">是经典陷阱——对象入字典后被修改，哈希桶对不上，键就“丢”了，表现为间歇性&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">KeyNotFoundException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">大小写与文化</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：字符串键默认区分大小写且用序比较；配置/协议解析建议&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">并发</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><code class="qk-md-code">Dictionary&lt;,&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;非线程安全，多线程读写不仅可能抛&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">KeyNotFoundException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，还可能内部死循环/数据损坏。读多写少可用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ConcurrentDictionary</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;或读写锁。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">值类型键</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">（如元组、struct）会造成装箱与较大内存开销；高频场景考虑&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Span</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">-based 查找或&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ImmutableDictionary</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">反序列化、配置映射缺失字段时，别依赖异常做“字段是否存在”的判断——用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">TryGetValue</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;才能区分“配置漏了”和“程序错了”。</span></li>
</ol>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.3 ArrayTypeMismatchException —— 协变数组的写入陷阱</h3>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i56.39f22988AvgD5q">引用类型数组允许协变（</span><code class="qk-md-code">string[]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;→&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">object[]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">），但运行时对象仍是子类型数组，因此</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i55.39f22988AvgD5q">每次写入都要做类型校验，失败就在写入那一行抛异常</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">。</span>赋值处永远不报错，错误被推迟到运行期。</span></p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>object[] arr = new string[1];
arr[0] = "hi";   // ✅
arr[0] = 42;     // 💥 ArrayTypeMismatchException
arr[0] = null;   // ✅ null 永远兼容
// object[] b = new int[3];  // ❌ 值类型不参与协变，编译期就拦住</code></pre>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph">
<table style="width: 89.0433%">
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="width: 1.44144%">#</th>
<th style="width: 20.8397%">场景</th>
<th style="width: 77.7189%">说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="width: 1.44144%">1</td>
<td style="width: 20.8397%"><code>params object[]</code></td>
<td style="width: 77.7189%">实参恰好是协变数组时零成本透传、不包层。<code>Log("api", tags)</code> 里 <code>tags</code> 仍是 <code>String[]</code>，方法内写入即炸。<code>(object[])tags</code> 只是引用转换，救不了；<code>(object)tags</code> 才包层，但语义变成“一个元素”</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 1.44144%">2</td>
<td style="width: 20.8397%"><code>Array.SetValue</code> / 反射</td>
<td style="width: 77.7189%">参数是 <code>object</code>，编译器无任何信息，全部推迟到运行期存储点</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 1.44144%">3</td>
<td style="width: 20.8397%"><code>Array.Copy</code></td>
<td style="width: 77.7189%">维度相同但某元素赋不进去时逐元素校验，可能拷了一半才炸，目标数组已污染。要“全或无”用 <code>Array.ConstrainedCopy</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 1.44144%">4</td>
<td style="width: 20.8397%">泛型里把 <code>T[]</code> 提升为 <code>object[]</code>/<code>Array</code> 去写</td>
<td style="width: 77.7189%"><code>where T : class</code> 时 <code>object[] o = arr;</code> 编译通过；<code>dynamic d = arr; d[0]=42;</code> 完全绕过编译检查</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 1.44144%">5</td>
<td style="width: 20.8397%"><code>IList&lt;T&gt;</code> 协变写入</td>
<td style="width: 77.7189%"><code>IList&lt;object&gt; list = new List&lt;string&gt;(); list.Add(42);</code> 💥</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 1.44144%">6</td>
<td style="width: 20.8397%"><code>Unsafe.As</code> / <code>MemoryMarshal.Cast</code></td>
<td style="width: 77.7189%">连运行期校验都绕过了——不抛异常，直接堆损坏。这是“协变最多只是抛异常”这一错觉的反例</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i64.39f22988AvgD5q">代价：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">类型安全：错误从编译期推到运行期，且堆栈离根因远。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">性能：每次写入插入类型校验；</span><code class="qk-md-code">Array.Copy</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;元素类型不一致时退化为逐元素拷贝，失去&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">memmove</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;快速路径。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">API：同一方法传字面量正常、传已有数组就炸，形成“海森堡式”接口。</span></li>
</ul>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>// 【如何避免？】
// A. 对外只用只读视图，物理上写不进去
void Print&lt;T&gt;(IReadOnlyList&lt;T&gt; items) { }
void Process&lt;T&gt;(ReadOnlySpan&lt;T&gt; data) { }

// B. params 方法体视为只读；要副本就造真 Object[]
object[] snap = new object[args.Length];
Array.Copy(args, snap, args.Length);   // ⚠️ (object[])args.Clone() 救不了，仍是 String[]

// C. 泛型写回保持 T[] 本体
static void Fill&lt;T&gt;(T[] arr, T val) =&gt; Array.Fill(arr, val);

// D. 异构容器别用数组：元组/record、List&lt;object&gt;、手动 union

// E. 反射写入前显式校验，统一转 ArgumentException</code></pre>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i67.39f22988AvgD5q">常用的几个排障要点：</span></p>
<ol class="qk-md-ol" start="1">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">判据</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：出现“读看基类、写希望是子类”的数组或&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IList&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，就是预备役；换成不变泛型集合问题当场消失。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">日志三件套</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><code class="qk-md-code">array.GetType().Name</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（真实运行时类型）、</span><code class="qk-md-code">GetElementType()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、待写值的&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">GetType()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">VS 异常设置中勾选“抛出时中断”，它默认不中断。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">测试补一条：传入派生类数组 + 写入不兼容值。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">不要 catch 它降级</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">——这是逻辑错误，不是数据问题。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">非泛型集合（</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArrayList</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">）不会抛这个，而是在</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">取出强转</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">时抛&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">InvalidCastException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，别混淆。</span></li>
</ol>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.4 RankException —— 维度不匹配</h3>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><code class="qk-md-code" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i70.39f22988AvgD5q">Rank</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;是数组的维度数（</span><code class="qk-md-code">int[,]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;→ 2，</span><code class="qk-md-code">int[][]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;→ 1）。该异常基本只出现在</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">数组拷贝族方法</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">中</span>：</span></p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>int[,] src = new int[2, 3];
int[] dst = new int[6];
src.CopyTo(dst, 0);             // 💥 RankException（2 维拷不进 1 维）

int[][] jagged = { new[] { 1, 2 }, new[] { 3, 4 } };
int[,] rect = new int[2, 2];
Array.Copy(jagged, rect, 2);    // 💥 RankException（jagged 的 Rank=1，且元素类型也不兼容）

// ✅ 先校验再按维遍历
void CopyChecked(Array src, Array dst)
{
    if (src.Rank != dst.Rank) throw new ArgumentException("维度数必须一致");
    for (int d = 0; d &lt; src.Rank; d++)
        if (src.GetLength(d) != dst.GetLength(d))
            throw new ArgumentException($"第{d}维长度不等");
    src.CopyTo(dst, 0);
}</code></pre>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i74.39f22988AvgD5q">特别注意：</span></span></div>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">交错数组&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">T[][]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;≠ 多维数组&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">T[,]</code></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">。前者是“一维数组套一维数组”，每行长度可不同、可在托管堆上不连续；后者是单个连续块。两者互拷必挂，序列化（BinaryFormatter/旧协议）互通也常踩坑。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">Array.CreateInstance</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;能造出</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">非零下界</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">的数组（</span><code class="qk-md-code">GetLowerBound(d) != 0</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">），这种数组传给很多只认 SZArray 的 API 会行为诡异；用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Array.IsSZArray</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（反射/内部）或统一要求&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">GetLowerBound(d)==0</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;做防御。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete">只接受一维数组的 API（如&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Array.Sort</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">BinarySearch</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、多数&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Buffer</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/</span><code class="qk-md-code">Marshal</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;操作）在传多维数组时通常抛&nbsp;</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentException</code></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;而非&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">RankException</code></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">——别因为没看到&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">RankException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;就以为维度没问题。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete">高性能场景优先用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Span&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/</span><code class="qk-md-code">Memory&lt;T&gt;</code></span><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">（天然一维连续）</span>，彻底告别维度问题。</span></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.5 InvalidOperationException —— 枚举期间集合被修改</h3>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i76.39f22988AvgD5q">枚举器内部持有&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">_version</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，集合每次增删改都会自增；</span><code class="qk-md-code">MoveNext()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;发现版本不一致就立即抛出&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">"Collection was modified; enumeration operation may not execute."</code></p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>var list = new List&lt;int&gt; { 1, 2, 3 };
foreach (var x in list)
    if (x == 2) list.Remove(x);        // 💥 下一轮 MoveNext 抛 InvalidOperationException

var dict = new Dictionary&lt;string,int&gt;{["a"]=1};
foreach (var k in dict.Keys) // 会抛异常的是增删操作（Add、Remove、Clear），它们会递增 _version
    dict.Remove(k);          // 💥 抛异常，InvalidOperationException
    // dict[k] = 2;          // 更新已有键的值时不会递增 _version，因此枚举器在下一轮 MoveNext 检测到版本一致，不会抛出异常

// ✅ 1) 倒序索引遍历（删除不移位影响后续下标）
for (int i = list.Count - 1; i &gt;= 0; i--)
    if (list[i] == 2) list.RemoveAt(i);

// ✅ 2) 先快照再遍历（简单粗暴，小集合首选）
foreach (var x in list.ToList())
    if (x == 2) list.Remove(x);

// ✅ 3) 用集合自身的高效批量 API
list.RemoveAll(x =&gt; x == 2);           // 一次遍历、无额外分配

// ✅ 4) 收集再删除（跨多个集合/复杂条件）
var toRemove = new List&lt;string&gt;();
foreach (var kv in dict) if (kv.Value &lt; 0) toRemove.Add(kv.Key);
foreach (var k in toRemove) dict.Remove(k);

// ✅ 5) 真正的并发读写
var cd = new ConcurrentDictionary&lt;string,int&gt;();
// 注意：ConcurrentDictionary 的枚举器是“某一时刻的快照”，修改不抛异常，
// 但可能看到重复/遗漏项——业务上仍需按幂等设计。</code></pre>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i80.39f22988AvgD5q">特别注意：</span></span></div>
<ul>
<li><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">延迟执行是隐形杀手</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><code class="qk-md-code">var q = list.Where(...)</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;只是表达式树，真正枚举可能在几层调用之后、甚至另一个线程里，那时原集合早被改了。需要尽早&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">.ToList()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/</span><code class="qk-md-code">.ToArray()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;物化，或传入不可变集合。</span></li>
<li><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">线程安全 ≠ 不抛这个异常</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：多线程共用一个&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Dictionary</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;即使不加修改，也可能因内部结构被破坏而抛&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IndexOutOfRangeException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;或死循环。</span><code class="qk-md-code">ConcurrentDictionary</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;只保证自身一致性，不保证“枚举期间全局静止”。</span></li>
<li><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">结构体枚举器的坑</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><code class="qk-md-code">List&lt;T&gt;.GetEnumerator()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;返回 struct，若被装箱成&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IEnumerator&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（如&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">foreach (var x in (IEnumerable&lt;int&gt;)list)</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">），每次&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Current</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;都是副本，可能出现“永远停在第一项”的怪象；同时修改检测依然生效。</span></li>
<li><span class="qk-md-text complete">同一异常的其他常见来源（便于搜日志时不误判）：</span><code class="qk-md-code">Single()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/</span><code class="qk-md-code">First()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;空集合、</span><code class="qk-md-code">Queue.Dequeue</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/</span><code class="qk-md-code">Stack.Pop</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;空、</span><code class="qk-md-code">IEnumerator</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;未&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">MoveNext</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;就读&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Current</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、LINQ 的&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">OrderBy</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;比较器违反约定、EF Core 的&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">DbContext</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;并发使用、</span><code class="qk-md-code">Task</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;重复&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Start</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">yield return</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;迭代器中状态非法。</span></li>
<li><span class="qk-md-text complete">ASP.NET Core 中最典型：把注入为 Scoped/Singleton 的可变集合作为全局缓存又在枚举时更新——要么换成&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ConcurrentDictionary</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，要么&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">lock</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;+ 快照。</span></li>
</ul>
<h2>三、通用排查清单</h2>
<ol class="qk-md-ol" start="1">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">先分类</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：带&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Index/Key/Rank/TypeMismatch</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;的 = bug；</span><code class="qk-md-code">InvalidOperationException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;= 状态或并发问题。前四类不建议在生产用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">try/catch</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;吞掉，应让它炸出来并带上上下文。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">日志必须带“边界信息”</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：抛的时候同时记&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">index / Length / Count / key / actualType / Rank / GetLength(d)</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，90% 的越界看这一行就能定位。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">边界用例单测</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：空集合、单元素、刚好满、多一、零长度数组、空字符串、Split 结果、非零下界数组、交错数组。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">用语言特性代替手写下标</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><code class="qk-md-code">foreach</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">^</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;与&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">..</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">Span&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、模式匹配、</span><code class="qk-md-code">ref</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;返回；需要下标时用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">for (int i = 0; i &lt; c.Count; i++)</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;并把上限缓存到局部变量（既防并发篡改长度，又帮 JIT 消除边界检查）。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">字典一律走&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">TryGetValue</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">GetValueOrDefault</code></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">；需要“不存在则计算插入”用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">GetOrAdd</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;或&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">GetValueRefOrAddDefault</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">API 设计层面消灭协变数组</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：参数用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IReadOnlyList&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/</span><code class="qk-md-code">ReadOnlySpan&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，返回用不可变集合；</span><code class="qk-md-code">params object[]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;重载要警惕传入的真实数组类型。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">并发</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：可变集合不出锁、不出线程边界；需要共享就用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Concurrent*</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;或&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Immutable*</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">；枚举期间要更新的，一律“快照或新建替换”。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">调试技巧</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：VS 里对&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IndexOutOfRangeException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;勾选“在该异常类型上中断”（它在默认设置里有时不被中断）；对偶发问题用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Debug.Assert(index &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; index &lt; arr.Length)</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，断言失败比异常更早、信息更全。</span></li>
</ol>
<h2>四、小小的总结</h2>
<p>这五个异常虽然触发点不同，但<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>本质都是契约被破坏，而非“数据不好”</strong></span>。</p>
<ul>
<li>IndexOutOfRangeException / KeyNotFoundException 是<strong>“越界与缺失”</strong>，属于访问前没做校验；</li>
<li>ArrayTypeMismatchException / RankException 是<strong>“类型与维度不匹配”</strong>，源于把本应由编译期或调用方保证的信息推迟到了运行期（协变数组、多维数组拷贝）；</li>
<li>InvalidOperationException 则是<strong>“状态不对”</strong>，多半是枚举期间修改集合或并发共享可变状态。</li>
</ul>
<p>它们的共同特征是：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>抛异常的位置往往离根因很远</strong></span>——赋值处不报错、写入处才炸；枚举器在下一轮 MoveNext 才报错；params object[] 的行为取决于调用者传的是字面量还是已有数组。因此，<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>把它们当成“可恢复的错误”去 catch 几乎总是错的，正确的做法是在入口和边界处就把它们消灭掉。</strong></span></p>
<p>落到工程实践上，可以只记三条规则：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>用 Try* 和长度判断替代下标与索引器</strong>（TryGetValue、GetValueOrDefault、ElementAtOrDefault、倒序遍历、RemoveAll）；</li>
<li><strong>用类型系统堵死协变与维度问题</strong>（对外只暴露 IReadOnlyList&lt;T&gt; / ReadOnlySpan&lt;T&gt;，params object[] 视为只读、要副本就造真 object[]，泛型代码绝不把 T[] 提升为 object[]）；</li>
<li><strong>让可变集合不出锁、不出线程边界，枚举期间一律快照或新建替换</strong>。</li>
</ol>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>配合日志里必记的边界信息（Length/Count/key/Rank/真实运行时类型）、VS 中勾选“抛出时中断”以及空集合与差一的单测，前四个异常可以做到线上零出现，剩下的 InvalidOperationException 也基本能被并发设计收敛掉。</strong></span></p>
<p>一句话：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>凡是能用长度判断、Try* API、不可变快照和泛型不变性挡住的，就不要留给运行时去抛。</strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
